Bergmann2001.citation: Bergmann et al. 2001, J Biomech (HIP98 / OrthoLoad)
Bergmann2001.notes: Instrumented hip implant contact force during walking, % body weight.

Giarmatzis2015.citation: Giarmatzis et al. 2015, J Bone Miner Res
Giarmatzis2015.notes: Hip contact force vs gait cycle at walking/running speeds (6-12 km/h). 'curve' = mean waveform; 'peak' series as stored in source .mat. Units multiples of body weight (xBW).

Hoang.citation: Hoang et al. (assisted gait, minimum-moment condition)
Hoang.notes: Assisted walking hip contact force, minimum-moment strategy. series mean/lower/upper form a confidence band.

Pandy2021.citation: Pandy et al. 2021, Scand J Med Sci Sports
Pandy2021.notes: Muscle forces over gait cycle for 10 muscles (GAS, GMAX, GMED, HAMS, IP, RF, SOL, VAS ...) across conditions FC1/FC7/FC19. y stored as in source (normalized).

Athlete03_GPK_squat.citation: Goncalves, powerlifting model project — Athlete 03, GPK model, 2025-03-31 session (unpublished)
Athlete03_GPK_squat.notes: Squat reference from this project's own OpenSim IK+ID and CEINMS runs, time-normalised to 0-100% of the trial. ONE athlete, two trials per condition (bodyweight and 35 kg), so 'lower'/'upper' are mean -+1 SD across trials, NOT a population range. Angles and moments are in the GPK model's own sign convention (knee flexion NEGATIVE) and are not flipped to any plotting convention. Built by bioscout-web/tools/squat_reference_from_sims.py.

Richards2018.citation: Richards et al. 2018 (knee contact force, normal walking) — CITATION TO CONFIRM
Richards2018.notes: Added to the manifest after being found in literature_curves.csv with no entry. Total, medial and lateral tibiofemoral contact force over the gait cycle, mean with a +-1 SD band. The citation line needs checking against the original before it is quoted.
